title: New volumes use topology.kubernetes.io/zone instead of topology.ebs.csi.aws.com/zone

detection.reason: what depends on the topology label (StorageClass allowedTopologies, scripts, policies) is not collected

quote: The AZ topology key `CreateVolume` returns has changed from `topology.ebs.csi.aws.com/zone` to `topology.kubernetes.io/zone`. Volumes created on `v1.33.0` or any future version will be incompatible with versions before `v1.28.0`. No other customer-facing impact is expected unless you directly depend on the topology label.
remediation: Check tooling that reads PV nodeAffinity or selects nodes/volumes on topology.ebs.csi.aws.com/zone (backup and migration tools, admission policies, scripts) and make it accept topology.kubernetes.io/zone: PVs created from v1.33 carry only the standard key. StorageClass allowedTopologies on the old key keep working (the controller still accepts it and nodes report both keys). After this upgrade do not roll the driver back below v1.28.
verifyCommand: kubectl get pv -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.csi.driver == "ebs.csi.aws.com") | "\(.metadata.name): \([.spec.nodeAffinity.required.nodeSelectorTerms[].matchExpressions[].key] | unique | join(","))"'  # PVs created before the upgrade show topology.ebs.csi.aws.com/zone, new ones topology.kubernetes.io/zone — tooling must read both
coversNotes: Migrate CreateVolume response topology to standard label topology.kubernetes.io/zone
